title: SES Raceday Tire
notes: Official store read 2026-11-01: US$100 per tire. 27-622 195 g, 50-85 psi (3.4-5.9 bar); 29-622 210 g, 40-80 psi (2.8-5.5 bar). 'Race Tire'; application 'Road Race / Triathlon / TT / Crit'; nano-technology enhanced compound, novel casing, aero SES tread; tubeless ready. 'As a pure performance tire, the SES Race Day prioritizes speed over puncture resistance and longevity.' No hookless statement on the page.
